blurb: Discover Toronto’s role in film and TV in this interactive self-guided walking tour. Follow the stars as you discover film sets and explore areas of the city that are highlighted in recent movies and TV shows. Finish with a walk along the Canadian Walk of Fame. Part scavenger hunt, part sightseeing, and part walking tour, this is a brand new experience that allows you to explore the city and find hidden gems at your own pace, using your smartphone. Ready, set, action!
